title: Distractor-Robust Reinforcement Learning via Variational Bisimulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34641v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) promises data efficiency and generalization, but typical reconstruction-based objectives encourage models to waste representational capacity on task-irrelevant distractors. We introduce VIBES (Variational Inference for Bisimulation-based Encoded States), a new objective that replaces pixel reconstruction with an adversarial term, which enforces that latent states suffice to predict both rewards and the next latent state. We show that this objective measures how far the encoder is from reward and dynamics sufficiency, and that whenever exact sufficiency is attainable, its global optima induce bisimulation relations on histories. Combined with a fixed-capacity latent bottleneck, this encourages latent states to retain task-relevant information while discarding irrelevant variation. translated_title: 通过变分互模拟实现干扰物鲁棒的强化学习
translated_abstract: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）有望实现数据高效性和泛化能力，但典型的基于重建的目标函数会促使模型把表征容量浪费在与任务无关的干扰物上。我们提出了VIBES（基于互模拟编码状态的变分推断），这是一种新的目标函数，用对抗项取代像素重建，该对抗项强制要求潜在状态足以预测奖励和下一个潜在状态。我们证明这一目标度量了编码器距离奖励与动力学充分性的远近，并且只要精确充分性可以实现，其全局最优解就会在历史序列上诱导出互模拟关系。结合固定容量的潜在瓶颈，这促使潜在状态保留与任务相关的信息，同时丢弃无关的变化。我们的方法可作为Dreamer模型学习组件的即插即用替代方案，实现了最先进的性能
tldr: 提出VIBES新目标，用对抗项取代像素重建并结合固定容量潜在瓶颈，使模型让潜在状态只需预测奖励与动态，从而丢弃无关干扰信息，显著提升强化学习对干扰物的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: VIBES replaces pixel reconstruction with an adversarial variational bisimulation objective and a fixed-capacity latent bottleneck, forcing latent states to capture only reward- and dynamics-relevant information so model-based RL becomes robust to distractors.
